name: section_heading
label: Section Heading
help_text: Main heading displayed at the top of the deals section.

label: Earnings Breakdown — Heading
help_text: Heading for the earnings stats card at the top of the page.

name: earnings_subheading
label: Earnings Breakdown — Subheading
help_text: Description below the Earnings Breakdown heading.
default: Track your referral commissions and see how your partnership with us is contributing to your success as a valued referral partner.

name: stat_zero_fallback
label: Earnings — Zero-State Fallback Text
help_text: Shown in BOTH the Total Fees Earned card AND the Total Fees Paid card when that card's computed total is $0 (e.g. the contact has no approved/paid deals yet). One field, two cards — write something that makes sense for either context. Partners see this text — define internal acronyms (e.g. BDM = Business Development Manager) before publishing if your audience may not know them. The card uses a smaller font in this fallback state so up to ~20 characters fit on one line.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Semantic heading level. Use H2 for a section heading, H1 only for the main page title.

name: add_deal_text
label: Register a Deal Button Text
help_text: Text on the button that opens the Register a Deal form modal.

name: filter_all_label
label: Filter: All Label
help_text: Label for the All filter tab.

name: filter_pending_label
label: Filter: Prospecting Label
help_text: Label for the Prospecting filter tab. (Internal filter key is `pending` — covers HubSpot deal stages appointmentscheduled + qualifiedtobuy + any deal with an unmapped stage. Renaming this label has no effect on the underlying filter.)

name: date_filter_dropdown_label
label: Date Filter: Dropdown Label
help_text: Short label shown to the LEFT of the date-range dropdown (e.g. "Date", "Registered", "Period"). Hidden on extra-narrow viewports if needed.

name: date_filter_all_label
label: Date Filter: All Time Option
help_text: Label for the default "all time" option in the date-range dropdown. Selecting this clears the date filter so all deals (regardless of when they were registered) are shown.

name: date_filter_this_month_label
label: Date Filter: This Month
help_text: Label for the "This month" option in the date-range dropdown. Filters to deals registered since the 1st of the current month (visitor's local timezone, inclusive).

name: date_filter_3m_label
label: Date Filter: Last 3 Months
help_text: Label for the "Last 3 months" option in the date-range dropdown. Filters to deals registered in the last 90 days (rolling window, visitor's local timezone, inclusive).

name: date_filter_12m_label
label: Date Filter: Last 12 Months
help_text: Label for the "Last 12 months" option in the date-range dropdown. Filters to deals registered in the last 365 days (rolling window, visitor's local timezone, inclusive).
